title: Form 425 transaction agreement package
filingText: Filed pursuant to Rule 425. Filed by: Example Acquirer Corp. Subject Company: Example Target Corp. The merger agreement and related employee communication are attached.

attachments.text:
AGREEMENT AND PLAN OF MERGER
This Agreement and Plan of Merger is entered into by Example Acquirer Corp., Merger Sub Inc., and Example Target Corp.
ARTICLE I THE MERGER
At the effective time, each outstanding target share will be converted into the right to receive the merger consideration.
ARTICLE VII CONDITIONS TO CLOSING
Closing remains subject to shareholder approval and regulatory clearance.

EMPLOYEE COMMUNICATION
Dear colleagues,
The merger agreement includes employee treatment provisions that apply after closing. Existing compensation and benefits remain unchanged before the transaction closes.
